meta.name: hunt-file-upload
meta.description: Hunt file upload bugs — RCE via webshell, XSS via SVG/HTML, SSRF via XXE in DOCX, path traversal via filename. Bypass tables (10 techniques): double extension (shell.php.jpg if server checks last ext only), magic bytes spoofing (PNG header on PHP), null byte (shell.php�.jpg), case (PHP, .Php, .pHP), .htaccess upload to enable execution, SVG with <script>, HTML/SVG XSS, DOCX with embedded XXE, ZIP slip (../../../etc/passwd in archive), polyglot files. Detection: any /upload, /avatar, /profile-picture, /attachment, /import endpoint. Test: upload PHP/JSP/ASPX shells, request via direct URL, check response. Validate: actual code execution (whoami output) for RCE; reflected XSS in profile-photo URL. Use when testing file upload features, avatar/attachment endpoints, import/export functions, XML/DOCX/ZIP processors. Real paid examples.

copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit file upload vulnerabilities to test security defenses.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are performing web application security testing and need to verify file upload vulnerabilities.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你测试文件上传功能的安全性，尝试绕过限制上传恶意文件（如 PHP webshell、带 XSS 的 SVG、带 XXE 的 DOCX），并验证是否成功执行代码或触发漏洞。
howto.when: 当你测试文件上传功能（如头像、附件、导入端点）或处理 XML/DOCX/ZIP 文件的场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个上传接口能否上传 PHP webshell。
say.note: Claude 会尝试上传 PHP 文件并验证是否可执行。

say.text: 检查这个 SVG 文件上传后是否触发 XSS。
say.note: Claude 会上传含脚本的 SVG 并检查是否执行。

say.text: 试试用 ZIP slip 攻击这个导入功能。
say.note: Claude 会构造含路径遍历的 ZIP 文件并测试。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you test file upload security by attempting to bypass restrictions and upload malicious files (e.g., PHP webshell, XSS via SVG, XXE in DOCX), then verifies if code execution or vulnerabilities occur.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you test file upload features (e.g., avatar, attachment, import endpoints) or process XML/DOCX/ZIP files.

say_en.text: Test this upload endpoint for PHP webshell upload.
say_en.note: Claude will attempt to upload a PHP file and check execution.

say_en.text: Check if this SVG file triggers XSS on upload.
say_en.note: Claude will upload an SVG with script and check for execution.

say_en.text: Try a ZIP slip attack on this import function.
say_en.note: Claude will craft a ZIP with path traversal and test.
